Here is some exploratory analysis of tilefish

```{r dealerbargraphs}

#Unique dealers

dealers_annual <- tile

colnames(dealers_annual)

# Year
dealers_by_year <- dealers_annual %>%
group_by(year) %>%
summarise(unique_dealers = n_distinct(dlrid))
print(dealers_by_year)


# By State
dealers_by_state <- dealers_annual %>%
group_by(state) %>%
summarise(unique_dealers = n_distinct(dlrid))
print(dealers_by_state)


# plot
dealers_annual %>% 
  group_by(year, state) %>% 
  summarise(count = n_distinct(dlrid), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = count, fill = state)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  labs(x = "Year") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))



```


After 2012, June-August started increasing in unique transactions for every year afterwards.
Throughout every year, Jan-May had much more unique transactions then later months in the spring.
Later winter starts picking up again.


```{r uniquetransactions}
# Price variables

 # 1. How many unique transactions are there in every month per year?

tile %>% 
  group_by(year, month) %>% 
  summarise(unique_transactions = n_distinct(camsid), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  kable()


# adding lndlb with unique transactions
tile %>% 
  group_by(year, month) %>% 
  summarise(
    unique_transactions = n_distinct(camsid),
    total_weight = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  arrange(year, month) %>% 
  mutate(
    display_value = paste0(
      scales::comma(unique_transactions), 
      " (", scales::comma(total_weight, accuracy = 0.1), "k)"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = year,
    names_from = month, 
    values_from = display_value,
    values_fill = "0"
  ) %>% 
  select(year, any_of(as.character(1:12))) %>%
  kable(format = "html", align = "c") %>% 
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

```



# 2006-2015 was landing more pounds

```{r market_desc}

# Month, Market_desc, and Year

tile %>% 
  apply_tilefish_market_rebinning() %>% 
  group_by(market_desc, month, year) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_unique_transactions = n_distinct(camsid),
    total_weight = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  arrange(market_desc, year, month) %>% 
  mutate(
    total_unique_transactions = scales::comma(total_unique_transactions),
    total_weight = scales::comma(total_weight)
  ) %>% 
  kable(
    format = "html", 
    align = "c", 
    col.names = c("Market Category", "Month", "Year", "Unique transactions", "Total Weight (1,000 lbs)")
  ) %>% 
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), 
    full_width = FALSE
  )

```


```{r}
#plot by market_desc

tile %>% 
  apply_tilefish_market_rebinning() %>% 
  group_by(market_desc, year) %>% 
  summarise(total_unique_transactions = n_distinct(camsid), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = total_unique_transactions, fill = market_desc)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Unique Transactions", fill = "Market Category") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

```
